product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires and equips boutique professional-services firms with custom AI and technology to help them serve accounting, tax, audit and advisory clients more effectively.
product_one_liner.notes: Product is a platform/model serving professional-services firms and their clients.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer includes no pricing link; public site positions a business-building/firm partnership model rather than priced SaaS plans.

named_customers.notes: These are portfolio operating firms, not outside client logos; the portfolio page lists them as businesses in the Multiplier platform.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 11–50; the requested available band most compatible with the smaller-company evidence is 11–20, though LinkedIn's range does not resolve the exact band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn gives headquarters as Singapore; company site also lists Singapore among its locations.

founded_year.notes: No reliable founding year for Multiplier Holdings itself was found; do not conflate it with the unrelated global-employment company Multiplier.

eng_blog.notes: The public Ideas/article index has essays and career/product topics, but does not show at least two engineering-authored technical build posts.

public_docs.notes: No product documentation, developer portal, or help center link appears in the navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists open roles, including a Director of Product, but no qualifying AI/ML/data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: No publicly named model/provider was found in the site materials reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: Reviewed privacy/security-related site material; it names none of the specified certifications.

last_funding.notes: Public launch announcement reported $27.5 million across seed and Series A funding, led by Lightspeed and Ribbit. The aggregate amount is reported for combined rounds; Series A is the latest disclosed stage.

raised_18mo.notes: Most recent funding announcement found was June 2025, outside the 18 months preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open roles are listed but none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable Ideas index has no launch-type announcement dated within the six-month window before 2026-11-09; the visible newer article items are not product launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A complete, checkable team page or reliable dated executive join/departure evidence was not found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Readable job and portfolio pages reviewed do not name CRM or sales/marketing systems.
